subtitle: Multidisciplinary Engineering Education
title: Engineering Disciplines
description: Master the complete spectrum of modern engineering — from software and electronics to robotics, AI, and advanced hardware systems.
software_desc: Full-stack systems, backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, AI systems, and distributed computing at scale.
software_details: In this program, you will explore scalable system design, database management, microservices architecture, and modern frameworks.
electrical_desc: Analog & digital electronics, PCB design, signal processing, power systems, and circuit architecture.
electrical_details: This program covers the complete lifecycle of electronics creation: from circuit simulation in SPICE to multi-layer PCB routing.
mechanical_desc: CAD systems, robotics mechanics, manufacturing, thermodynamics, and aerospace engineering principles.
mechanical_details: Master the principles of mechanism design, Finite Element Analysis (FEA), thermodynamics, and modern manufacturing methods.
embedded_desc: STM32, microcontrollers, FPGA systems, IoT devices, firmware development, and sensor integration.
embedded_details: Dive into bare-metal microcontroller programming in C/C++, work with Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS), and design custom FPGA architectures.
robotics_desc: Autonomous systems, motion control, computer vision, sensor fusion, and AI-powered robotics.
robotics_details: Learn how to bring machines to life. The program includes studying the Robot Operating System (ROS), kinematics, and processing data.
ai_desc: Machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, computer vision, NLP, and production AI systems.
ai_details: Master neural network training architectures, work extensively with Large Language Models (LLMs) and computer vision.
systems_desc: Complex system design, integration, architecture, verification, and large-scale engineering projects.
systems_details: Learn to see the big picture: from comprehensive requirements management to cross-disciplinary subsystem integration.
hardware_desc: Custom silicon design, hardware prototyping, manufacturing, testing, and product engineering.
hardware_details: Take projects from concept to finished device. Design custom silicon (ASIC), create rapid hardware prototypes, and conduct rigorous testing.
